verifier: openadapt-flow verify-run, rest on GET /api/db, with a baseline
verify_yaml:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
verifier:
  kind: rest
  base_url: <fault server>
  records_path: /api/db
effects:
  - kind: record_written
    match:
      patient_id: {param: patient_id}
      type: {literal: Triage}
      note: {param: note}
    expected_count: 1
    count_new_only: true

corrections.why: the page was opened with idempotency=demo, so the app sent a fixed idempotency key and the server de-duplicated the double send; these were clean saves under a key, not duplicate faults. Real duplicate items (no key) are items 36-40.
